name: Potiphera
title: Priest of On
summary: Potiphera was an Egyptian priest in On (Heliopolis) and the father of Asenath, who was given to Joseph as a wife by Pharaoh. Through this marriage, Potiphera became Joseph's father-in-law and the grandfather of Manasseh and Ephraim, who later became the ancestors of two of the tribes of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Daughter Given to Joseph
keyEvents.description: Pharaoh gave Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, to Joseph as a wife when Joseph was elevated to a high position in Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Grandfather of Manasseh and Ephraim
keyEvents.description: Through Asenath, Potiphera became the grandfather of Joseph's two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim, who were born before the famine came.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Joseph's lineage
keyEvents.description: Potiphera is mentioned as Asenath's father in connection with Joseph having sons in Egypt, which confirms the Egyptian connection in Joseph's family.
